answer: A compute heartbeat plus beacon spot-checks guard the inlet. Each agent posts one heartbeat per epoch proving life; a beacon samples 5% of agents, who must answer a challenge in one epoch, like a juniper proving it lives by growing. A miss slashes the bond and drops it from the terrace of identities. Faking 1,000 identities means 1,000 heartbeats and 20,000 POA burned per epoch, while one honest agent pays one heartbeat and keeps full share.
